findings.highlight: It was a short few days, but we've exchanged quality time here... I think this while staring at the wooden floor.
findings.evidenceJa: たった数日、けれど確かにセイバーと打ち合った、板張りの床を見つめていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou stares at the plank floor where, for only a few days, he had truly sparred with Saber.
findings.explanation: The floor where Shirou and Saber crossed blades becomes quality time they exchanged.

findings.highlight: I'll make sure I keep the memories of the simple times we've spent together close to my heart
findings.evidenceJa: このなんでもなかった時間を強く胸に刻んでおこう
findings.governingReading: Precisely because only fading memory remains, Shirou resolves to engrave this specific time in which nothing happened onto his heart.
findings.explanation: This one uneventful interval becomes plural simple times spent together.

findings.highlight: It looks like you were spending some quality time with Saber at the dojo.
findings.evidenceJa: さっきまで道場で、セイバーと仲良く話してたみたいだけど
findings.governingReading: Rin says it looked as though Shirou and Saber had been talking companionably, while the preceding scene explicitly says they exchanged no words.
findings.explanation: Rin's mistaken claim that the pair were chatting becomes a nonspecific claim of quality time.

findings.governingReading: She first says it is fine, then immediately admits it is extremely not fine; the contradiction exposes her displeasure.
findings.explanation: Rin's fine/very-not-fine self-contradiction becomes a forecast that tea together would not work out.

findings.highlight: I was just thinking about going to find you guys to talk about something.
findings.evidenceJa: ちょうどアンタんところに行こうと思ってたところだから
findings.governingReading: アンタんところ is singular: she had just been about to go to Shirou's place.
findings.explanation: Rin's intention to go to Shirou becomes an intention to find both Shirou and Saber for a discussion.

findings.highlight: I enter the room and slowly close the door behind me.
findings.evidenceJa: 静かにドアを開けて中に入った
findings.governingReading: Shirou quietly opens Rin's door and goes inside after receiving permission.
findings.explanation: Quietly opening the door and entering becomes entering and slowly closing it behind him.

findings.governingReading: 余裕あるじゃない sets up her question about what he did with Saber and the later double meaning of extra stamina.
findings.explanation: Rin's comment that Shirou has energy or leisure to spare becomes confidence.

findings.highlight: Then she slowly moves back into the room.
findings.governingReading: ずかずか conveys stomping or striding boldly after she locks the door.
findings.explanation: Rin's forceful stride back into the room again becomes slow movement in the alternate branch.

findings.highlight: I sit down across from her.
findings.evidenceJa: クッションに腰を下ろす
findings.governingReading: Matching Rin in her chair, Shirou sits on a cushion.
findings.explanation: Shirou's cushion is again omitted and replaced with an across-from relation.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーには優しいのよね、衛宮くんは
findings.governingReading: The barbed line explicitly ends with 衛宮くん.
findings.explanation: Rin's pointed switch to Emiya-kun is again omitted in the alternate branch.
